Census enumeration advanced in four poll-bound states

The census enumeration process has been advanced to December in four states that are scheduled to go to polls. This decision affects states that will hold elections soon. The exact dates for the enumeration in December have not been specified in the coverage. The purpose of advancing the census process is to complete it before the elections.
